category_title: Bored students who engage in off-task behaviors
scenario_title: Fear of asking questions and humiliation
minimal_context: The student is asked to solve an equation on the board in front of the class after a lecture.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have finished lecturing on this topic. Please come to the board and solve the first equation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks to the board hesitantly) I don't know what to write.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write down your first step.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Writes an incorrect formula on the board) Is this right?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, that is incorrect. (Gives an intense look)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm going back to my desk. You frighten me with your intense look. Whenever we do a mistake during the class, it feels like you humiliate us before our friends. I'm afraid of you, so I cannot ask you to repeat the subject we don't understand.
